Adventurer’s Clothes.Description: Standard gear for any adventurer, as tough as these clothes are made, they sadly don’t offer any additional protection.

Leather Bracers.Description: Some rather cool looking toughened leather that protects the important bits. It doesn’t offer much additional protection but its better then nothing and doesn’t restrict Movement at all.
Leather Bracers.Traits: Characters wearing this armor have +1 to Defense.

Leather Armor.Description: Tanned hide that offers a decent amount of protection, and doesn’t compromise on dexterity or stealth. It’s best not to think too hard about where the hide came from.
Leather Armor.Traits: Characters wearing this armor have +1 to Defense and +1 to Special Defense.

Chain Mail.Description: This cheap and light metal Armor offers decent protection and ease of movement, but makes a decent amount of noise.
Chain Mail.Traits: Characters wearing this armor have a +2 to Defense, +1 to Special Defense. They have -3 successes to Stealth checks however.

Flak Armor.Description: Layered Kevlar and steel armor, often worn by military personnel, it offers decent protection where it covers, without reducing movement too much.
Flak Armor.Traits: Characters wearing this armor have a +2 to Defense and a +2 Special Defense. Their Dexterity is reduced by 1 however.

Half Plate.Description: Samurai, knights and mercenaries typically wear something like this. A step above chain mail. Its very protective, while still being easy enough to Move in.
Half Plate.Traits: Characters wearing this armor require at least 2 Strength. They have a +3 to Defense and a +2 Special Defense. Their Dexterity is reduced by 1 however.

Full Plate.Description: The gold standard in protection. Only those with money can afford it. It offers brilliant protection but reduces Movement considerably.
Full Plate.Traits: Characters wearing this armor require at least 3 Strength. They have +3 to Defense and +3 to Special Defense. Their Dexterity is reduced by 2 however.

Carapace Armor.Description: The gold standard in protection. Only those with money can afford it. It offers brilliant protection but reduces Movement considerably.
Carapace Armor.Traits: Characters wearing this armor require at least 3 Strength. They have +3 to Defense and +3 to Special Defense. Their Dexterity is reduced by 2 however.
